{{Quote|It was night in our palace&mdash;were you awake or asleep, with Mother... or alone?|Leia Organa|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 53">[[Star Wars (1977) 53|''Star Wars'' (1977) 53]]</ref>}}
The '''Royal Palace of Alderaan''', also known as '''House Organa''', was an elegant, [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old building in the heart of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In the waning [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it was home to the [[House of Organa/Legends|Royal House of Organa]], and the palace from which [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]] ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The young [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the adopted daughter of Queen Breha and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], was raised in this [[Castle/Legends|castle]], along with her foster sister [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], her aunts [[Tia Organa]], [[Rouge Organa]] and [[Celly Organa/Legends|Celly Organa]] and other members of the extended family. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Alderaanian government became a threat to the rise of the ever-rising [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Royal Palace was presumed destroyed with the planet when [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] demonstrated the power of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] on Alderaan. In spite of the planetary destruction, a large portion of the Palace had been preserved within the rocky mass of the [[Asteroid 7785]].

==History==
{{Quote|When I was living in my father's palace, I was utterly bored, Luke.|Leia Organa|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
[[File:AlderaLake-ROTS.png|thumb|left|240px|The Palace overlooked a [[Aldera lake|vast lake]]]]
Relative to the millennia of history of the Alderaanian [[King/Legends|monarchy]], the Royal Palace of Aldera was recently built. It was constructed in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] around [[719 BBY/Legends|719 BBY]],<ref name="RoDV" /> in the first [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="CSWEgpr">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> In the millennia which preceded its construction, the monarchs of Alderaan had held court in various [[Castle/Legends|castles]]&mdash;including the [[Castle Panteer|ancestral home]] of [[House Panteer]] in the [[Glarus Valley]].<ref name="TORcodexGV">{{TORcite|type=codex|Glarus Valley}}</ref>

In the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], tensions arose between the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] as to whether the line of ascent to [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] should go to the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] or another family.<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> In [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="AoE6">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref> the resulting crisis, known as the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]], was resolved by [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] [[Jorus C'baoth]], who ended the dispute by joining the Organas and the [[House of Antilles|Antilles]] through [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]].<ref name="Pello Scrambas">{{DB|character|pelloscambras|Scrambas, Pello}}</ref> As a result, united members of both houses inhabited the Royal Palace&mdash;including the Viceroy Bail Prestor Organa and his wife, [[King/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]], née Antilles.<ref name="RoDV" /> The building itself, however, remained the property of the Organas<ref name="SOTME">In the novel ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] referred to the Royal Palace as belonging to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|her father]] rather than [[Breha Organa/Legends|her mother]].</ref> and was thus referred to as "House Organa."<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

Following the devastating conflicts of the three-year-long [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the royal couple adopted the daughter of the late [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="RoDV" /> The young [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] grew up in the Palace with her adoptive parents.<ref name="LJMoD">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref> Meanwhile, the galaxy still bore the scars of the war, and it was decided that Alderaan would be disarmed completely. The [[Alderaanian War Frigate|war frigate]] ''[[Another Chance]]'' was converted into an armory ship in which all the weapons of war of Alderaan were stored. The frigate was programmed to continually jump through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] until recalled on Alderaan by the [[Council of Elders (Alderaan)|Council of Elders]]. The command chamber of the ''Another Chance'' was hidden within the Royal Palace of Aldera.<ref name="GoA" /> Around the same period, a series of demonstrations took place around the Palace when the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to increase the restrictions on the refugees that had found shelter on Alderaan. However, the Alderaanian law enforcement units managed to confine the protestors to a preassigned circuit, and the Royal Palace did not suffer any damage.<ref name="LJMoD" />

[[File:Aldera-HardTargets5.png|thumb|240px|The Royal Palace around 3 BBY]]
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the Palace hosted the festivities of the twenty-fifth anniversary of the Ascendancy Contention, with nobles from other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] being invited by Queen Breha and her husband Bail Organa. On that occasion, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Adan Dooku]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] was murdered by Imperial agent [[Jahan Cross]] inside the very walls of the Palace.<ref name="AoE6" /> [[2 BBY/Legends|One year later]], the Palace became one of the crucibles from which the rebellion against the Empire emerged: following the [[Cantham House/Legends|Cantham House]] [[Cantham House Meetings|Meetings]], Bail Organa joined with [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] to [[Corellian Treaty|form]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> However, in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] grew suspicious of Bail Organa's loyalty, and he decided to make an example. Tarkin used the immense firepower of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]]-sized [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] equipped with a planet-killing [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], on Alderaan. The Aldera Royal Palace was presumed destroyed along with the planet itself and its millions of inhabitants.<ref name="ANH" />

===Partial survival===
{{Quote|They found the Palace. The Royal Palace. It's in the Graveyard. Go to Mining Outpost 11. The report was filed there. One scout also said they found... Bail Organa... hurry...|[[Zaz Kamiroz]]|<ref name="GoA" />}}
[[File:Hologhost_in_the_ruins.png|thumb|left|150px|A holographic "ghost" of Darth Vader in the ruins of the palace]]
Some time later, a group of Rebels intercepted a message meant for Princess Leia Organa, claiming that the Royal Palace had been found intact somewhere in [[the Graveyard]]&mdash;an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] created by the destruction of the planet Alderaan. Following the lead, the Rebel agents reached the [[Asteroid 7785]], where a significant portion of the Aldera Royal Palace had indeed been preserved. Unbeknownst to them, the message had been sent by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. By providing such information, Vader hoped he could lure Leia Organa and any other of the survivors of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to Alderaan, where the Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Janus Bonn]] waited for them.<ref name="GoA" />

Vader's trap was sprung, but not on its intended victims. While exploring the ruined section of the palace, the Rebels stumbled upon various frightening holograms that had been implanted by the Imperials to instil fear in the visitors. After defeating Janus Bonn and his henchmen, the agents of the Alliance discovered the hidden room from which the frigate ''Another Chance'' could be called back.<ref name="GoA" />

==Layout==
===External layout===
[[File:Aldera_palace_dome.png|thumb|200px|The Grand Reception Room was contained within a dome.]]
Built at the heart of the city,<ref name="TPS" /> the Royal Palace lay on a slight rise at the edge of Aldera, overlooking the vast lake. It was a compound of multistoried buildings and turrets, surrounded by ramparts<ref name="LJMoD" /> and defensive moats filled with [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="RoDV" /> The Palace appeared as an assemblage of shallow domes and tall, sharp spires that gleamed [[Color/Legends|white]] and [[Gold/Legends|gold]] in the daylight.<ref name="TPS" /> A beautiful ensemble of orchards and gardens surrounded the castle's outer enclosure, and several terraces were built on various levels, providing the inhabitants with fresh air and light.<ref name="LJMoD" /> The North tower was equipped with a lofty balcony, from which the old moats and the palace's ramparts could be seen unobstructed. [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] viewed a series of demonstrations from this tower in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="RoDV" />

The way to the main gates of the Palace went through a twisting path in the middle of a blooming garden, lined with majestic dark golden [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. The front entrance itself was a wide [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] door ornamented with intricate carvings. There were other entrances to the castle, including one in the curved South wall, another in the East wall,<ref name="RoDV" /> and another gate the royal family used to enter and exit their private wing in the back of the castle.<ref name="LJMoD" />

Since no weapons were allowed on Alderaan, the security measures around the palace were almost non-existent. The palace had been conceived as an open place, where any Alderaanian could ask for access. While the defensive moats had once been in use, they were considered obsolete in the last decades of the Republic.<ref name="LJMoD" /> However, following the end of the Clone Wars, the outside of the Palace was protected by the [[Alderaan Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]].<ref name="RoDV" />

===Internal layout===
{{Quote|We don't know the palace very well. You see, we've only been with our present master for two local months, and we're not very well acquainted with the layout.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="RoDV" />}}
[[File:Aldera_palace_ballroom.png|thumb|left|250px|One of the castle's ballrooms]]
The multistory building included kilometers of winding corridors and all manner of [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedrooms]], ballrooms and reception rooms.<ref name="RoDV" /> The Palace featured a [[Grand Reception Room]] contained within a dome-shaped structure,<ref name="AoE6" /> a [[Grand Ballroom (Aldera Royal Palace)|Grand Ballroom]] with a marble staircase,<ref name="RFH">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref> a throne room, a bridge-spanned reflecting pool, and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] [[Bail Organa's office (Alderaan)/Legends|study]]&mdash;which overlooked the lake and was surrounded by gardens.<ref name="RoDV" />

The palace's most formal room was topped by a domed ceiling and paneled with wood. There was no furniture inside, and a massive, [[Star/Legends|sun]]-shaped lighting fixture hung from the ceiling. The Royal family would discuss their most ceremonial affairs in this space.<ref name="LJMoD" />

One of the Palace's entrances led to the First Hall, one of the many ceremonial chambers located within the Palace. The First Hall was long hallway decorated with statues, [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-art and sculptures. It provided access to a series of offices, most of which were occupied by low-ranking [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]]. One of those hosted the [[Alderaan Department of the Arts]]; various holoposters and four desks with data viewers were placed in that office. By walking past the suite of offices, visitors could reach the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Grand Hall]],<ref name="GoA" /> an ornately decorated chamber, the Grand Hall in which the royalty of Alderaan held court.<ref name="TG">{{DoD|The Traitor's Gambit}}</ref> That second hallway was lined with pillars and featured a grand staircase that led to a lower level. Down the steps of the Grand Hall lay another series of chambers, which included a map room that contained a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] of the Republican space. There were also a meeting chamber, a steam bath room, the dining hall and the lounge of the Council of Elders and the Amphitheater. That final room not only hosted the official gatherings of the Elders, but also contained the only possible access to the castle's best kept secret: the hidden chamber from which the armory ship ''Another Chance'' could be called back.<ref name="GoA" />

[[File:Bail_comforting_Leia.png|thumb|250px|Leia and Bail Organa in the latter's study]]
The private wing of the Royal family was located at the back side of the Palace. This private compound contained a room nicknamed the "[[inside-outside room]]." It was equipped with [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] doors marching along a wall so that the surrounding gardens would be seen in full display. The Royal family often gathered in this room in the mornings and evenings because the sunset light made it gleam like a flower.<ref name="LJMoD" /> The bedroom in which Princess Leia slept had a window which opened on the palace grounds, and a tree with low-hanging branches allowed the young girl to go over the wall at night. ''[[Killik Twilight]]'', a [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]] by the famous Alderaanian artist [[Ob Khaddor]], usually hung outside the Princess' bedroom&mdash;although it could be borrowed for art exhibits.<ref name="TUF" /> In addition to their bedrooms, ladies of the court like [[Rouge Organa]] could also possess their own boudoir.<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

Honored guests had the benefit of their own wing, which was located a long distance from the main reception room of the castle.<ref name="RoDV" /> One such guest suite was prepared for Count Adan Dooku shortly before his assassination. Those particular chambers featured a balcony, scarlet floor tiles, wide windows an a large, round bench settee.<ref name="AoE6" />
